import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

selection_path=Path('results/training/qwen38_selection.json'); selection=json.loads(selection_path.read_text())
completion_path=Path('results/training/qwen38_selected_test_completion.json'); completed=json.loads(completion_path.read_text())
assert completed['selection_sha256']==file_sha256(selection_path)
canonical=Path(selection['test_root']); copied={}
for game, players in completed['cohorts'].items():
 if not all(c['complete'] for c in players.values()): continue
 for name,c in players.items():
  source=Path(c['file']); assert file_sha256(source)==c['sha256'] and c['episodes']==200
  target=canonical/f'raw/{game}/{name}.jsonl'; target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  if target.exists(): assert file_sha256(target)==file_sha256(source)
  else: shutil.copyfile(source,target)
  copied[str(target)]=file_sha256(target)
r={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'Publish only complete canonically verified frozen-policy games for scoring'},selection['provenance']['model_revision']),
 'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'selection_sha256':file_sha256(selection_path),'completion_receipt':str(completion_path),
 'completion_receipt_sha256':file_sha256(completion_path),'canonical_copies':copied,
 'scope':'Dice complete n200; partial cards192 remain only in original downloads until the one authorized continuation finishes. No partial cohort score or extrapolation.'}
Path('results/training/qwen38_complete_game_publication.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Published',len(copied),'complete raw cohorts')
